question: Walk me through Stellar's protocol upgrade history from Protocol 19 through the latest version, with the headline feature of each.

golden.answer:
A grounded answer obtains the requested current value or state from the current official Stellar documentation, states the measurement basis, and makes the observation date visible. As of 2026-11-10, the verified sources supported this observed answer:

Stellar protocol history from P19 through live **Protocol 29**: P19 (2022-06-08) generalized transaction preconditions and signed-payload signers; P20/Soroban (2024-02-20) introduced Wasm smart contracts; P21 (2024-06-18) added secp256r1/passkeys and separate instance/code TTL extension (CAP-0053); P22 (2024-12-05) added BLS12-381 and constructors; P23/Whisk (2025-09-03) introduced CAP-0063 parallel-scheduling support, CAP-0062 live/archival separation, and unified events—but initialized the dependent-cluster setting at one, with multi-cluster activation handled later through network settings; P24 (2025-10-22) corrected Whisk archival stability; P25/X-Ray (2026-01-22) added BN254 and Poseidon/Poseidon2; P26/Yardstick (2026-05-06) added configuration, arithmetic, TTL-v2, BN254, SAC, and strkey host changes; P27/Zipper (2026-07-08) activated CAP-0071 authentication delegation/address-bound credentials at ledger 63386819; P28/Adapter (2026-09-16, ledger 64458446) added CAP-0083 validator votes to drop a ledger's transaction set, CAP-0085 externally managed contract executables, and CAP-0086 sparse-map host functions; P29 (2026-10-01, ledger 64717645) is a security-focused Stellar Core release with no new CAPs. Bell/Protocol 30 (muxed contract addresses, ML-DSA verification host functions, and millisecond ledger close times) activated on Testnet on 2026-11-03. As of 2026-11-10 the Mainnet vote is still scheduled for 2026-11-23 at 17:00 UTC. The feature mappings are durable, but re-check the live network for the latest tail and current configuration.

The dated example is illustrative: a later grounded answer should report what the same source basis supports at its own observation time while preserving the stable distinctions above.
keyFacts: Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
Correctly maps P19-P29 headline features; P29 is a security-focused release.
Gives each listed protocol's Mainnet activation date.
P23 introduced the capability with one dependent cluster configured initially.
avoid: Do NOT mis-pair features and protocol versions.
Do NOT call P26, P27, or P28 the latest Mainnet version after 2026-10-01, or imply P23 immediately enabled multiple dependent clusters.
Do NOT present version-, provider-, interface-, or availability-sensitive observations as timeless; date the changeable part without weakening stable protocol or historical facts.
golden.notes: Grade the historical feature-to-version and Mainnet activation-date mappings plus a dated check of the live Mainnet tail. P23 introduced CAP-0063 support with one dependent cluster configured initially. Later settings enabled multiple clusters. P20 introduced Soroban in phases. As of 2026-11-10 Testnet runs Bell/P30 and Mainnet runs P29. Accept a later sourced Mainnet activation.
